summary: The diff implements a comprehensive file storage module with backend data models, CRUD operations, frontend UI components, React Query hooks, navigation integration, dashboard card, and Persian translations. All major requirements are addressed with evidence in backend/main.mo, hooks, pages, components, and translations. However, the binary content upload/download implementation details are truncated, and export/import does not show explicit handling of file content (only metadata), which aligns with the stated constraint that binary content is excluded from export/import.
